newsitem.title: CHINA: Deng successor reads eulogy to late China leader.
newsitem.headline: Deng successor reads eulogy to late China leader.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin, who took up the mantle of supreme power when Deng Xiaoping died last week, on Tuesday began reading the eulogy to the man who brought his people prosperity, but under communist control.
Choking with emotion, Jiang began to voice the grief of China's 1.2 billion people for Deng Xiaoping, who died last Wednesday aged 92.
His voice breaking amid sobs, Jiang wiped tears from his eyes.
"The people of China love Comrade Deng Xiaoping... we miss comrade Deng Xiaoping," Jiang said.
Jiang stood in front of a huge portrait of Deng, draped in black ribbons and surrounded by huge bouquets of flowers and evergreen cypress trees -- symbol of long life in China.

"Carry forward the behest of Comrade Deng Xiaoping and advance the great cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics under the leadership of the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin at the core," read one banner in the Great Hall of the People.
